about-intro:
Technology teacher leading educational robotics projects with Arduino. I walk with my students from the idea to the working prototype: I challenge them to research, organize them in teams with roles, guide them through assembly and programming, and encourage them to present their results to the community.
More than 20 years of technology experience put at the service of the classroom.
about-tagline: I lead my students through Arduino robotics projects, guiding them to design, program and present prototypes that solve real problems around them.
projects-more: These are four of the projects I have led with my students. There are others — at different levels and on different topics — that I am happy to share if you get in touch.
